title: Juicy Savory Malaysian Tofu Tagine
description: A savory and light Malaysian dish featuring tofu in a rich tomato sauce, cooked to perfection in a tagine and wrapped in lotus leaf, perfect for a festive occasion. This plant-based friendly recipe is a delight to the senses.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cumin and coriander to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tomato sauce to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Add the tofu to the pan and stir gently to combine with the sauce.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Prepare the lotus leaves by washing and drying them, then cutting out the stem and any thick veins.
Spoon the tofu and sauce mixture onto the center of each lotus leaf, then fold the leaves over the filling to form a tight packet.
Place the packets in a tagine or a large Dutch oven and cover with a lid.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until the sauce is bubbly and the lotus leaves are tender.
